scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @replayops/api" "npm run dev --workspace @replayops/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @replayops/api && npm run build --workspace @replayops/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @replayops/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @replayops/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @replayops/api && npm run test --workspace @replayops/web
